about.hero_desc: We build tools that align human cognitive capacity with personalized artificial intelligence. Our vision is to optimize how the brain retains languages.
about.pillar1_desc: Applying spaced repetition, active recall, and structured progression to build memory paths that stick.
about.pillar2_desc: Adapting materials based on real-time weakness analysis. No generic pathways, only targeted modules.
about.pillar3_desc: Helping students and professionals achieve verifiable fluency markers (IELTS, JLPT, Business Proficiency).
about.ora_desc: Traditional language tools treat every user identically, which leads to boredom or discouragement. Langora operates dynamically — it adjusts content to match your speed, alerts you to vocab you're about to forget, and checks your written structure with specialized language models.
